# Verify user token

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P1 · Who did it](../README.md#phase-1--who-did-it) · **Lane:** Worker · **Label:** `feature:identity-verification` · **Epic:** [#20](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/20) · **Tickets:** 5 (1S 4M)

The worker reads a user token from Proxy-Authorization on CONNECT or from X-Warden-Identity after TLS termination. It verifies the token against the issuer's JWKS, strips it before forwarding, and attaches sub, email, groups and sid to every event, receipt and decision log. Each agent's identity mode is off or attribute, so P1 attributes requests and never blocks for a missing token.

## How we build it

- New package `internal/identity`: `Claims{Sub, Email, Groups, SID, Issuer, Expiry}`, a `Verifier` interface `Verify(ctx, raw string) (Claims, error)`, and an OIDC implementation on `github.com/coreos/go-oidc/v3` RemoteKeySet (JWKS cached, refetched on unknown kid, at most one fetch per 30s). It checks iss, that aud contains the configured audience, exp/nbf with 60s skew, and an algorithm allowlist (RS256, ES256). A fake verifier lives in test/fakes.
- Config is distributed in `SettingsWire.Identity{Mode, Issuer, Audience, PerAgent map[agentID]mode}` and applied by the SettingsApplier. Valid modes are `off|attribute`, and `require` fails validation with a 'Phase 2' error. The agent stays identified by port (`agentid.PortBindingIdentifier`).
- Extraction: the `handleConn` header loop captures `Proxy-Authorization` (Basic user `session` -> token; Bearer also accepted). A new first request stage `identityStage` reads `X-Warden-Identity: Bearer`. Both headers are always deleted before forwarding, even in mode off. If CONNECT and header identities differ in sub, the result is 403 `identity_conflict`.
- Failure in attribute mode: the request proceeds, `IdentityStatus` is set to `none|valid|invalid|expired`, and the metric `warden_identity_verify_total{result}` is incremented. The raw token is never logged, stored or passed to the judge.
- Event gains `UserSub, UserEmail, UserGroups, UserSID, IdentityStatus`. These are additive SQLite columns on the local and fleet stores, flow through sync/ingest, and are covered by signed receipts automatically because `Signer.Sign` marshals the whole Event.

## Done when

A request through a worker in attribute mode with a valid Dex token produces an event, receipt and decision log carrying the user's sub/email/groups, and the upstream never sees the token. Invalid, expired and missing tokens are recorded with their status and still allowed.

### 1/5 · W-P1-VRFY-01

**Add internal/identity OIDC verifier with cached JWKS and config**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#21](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/21)

Create new package `internal/identity` with `Claims`, the `Verifier` interface, and `NewOIDCVerifier(ctx, Config{Issuer, Audience, ClockSkew, JWKSURL})` built on go-oidc v3 (`oidc.NewRemoteKeySet` plus `IDTokenVerifier` with `SkipClientIDCheck` and a manual aud-contains check, so tokens with aud=[warden,...] pass). Add `config.IdentitySettings` to `SettingsWire` and a local `identity:` YAML block, validated as above. Add `fakes.Verifier` to test/fakes.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Tests against an httptest JWKS cover valid, wrong iss, wrong aud, expired, nbf in future, alg none and HS256 (all rejected except valid)
- [ ] Key rotation: a token signed by a new kid verifies after one JWKS refetch
- [ ] SettingsWire JSON with identity round-trips, and mode `require` fails validation

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-DEX-01`](dex-oidc.md#13--w-p1-dex-01) Add reference Dex config with warden and agent-harness clients

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-SSO-03`](console-sso-rbac.md#36--w-p1-sso-03) Implement OIDC login/callback with PKCE on the control plane; [`W-P1-VRFY-02`](identity-verification.md#25--w-p1-vrfy-02) Extract, verify and strip identity on CONNECT and requests

### 2/5 · W-P1-VRFY-02

**Extract, verify and strip identity on CONNECT and requests**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#22](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/22)

In `internal/proxy/serve.go`, capture `Proxy-Authorization` in the header loop, verify it via `p.identity()` (an atomic holder like `secretsP`), and pass the resolved identity into `handleTLS`/`tunnel` and onto `requestScope.identity`. Add `identityStage` as the first step in `runRequestStages`. It reads and deletes `X-Warden-Identity`, deletes `Proxy-Authorization`, and resolves conflicts with 403 `identity_conflict`. Resolve the per-agent mode from SettingsWire using the worker's agentID, and wire the verifier through `internal/worker` assembly and hot-reload.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] The upstream test server never sees X-Warden-Identity or Proxy-Authorization
- [ ] In mode off, no verification is attempted and headers are still stripped
- [ ] In attribute mode, an invalid token is forwarded without the header, with status invalid; a conflicting sub gets 403

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-VRFY-01`](identity-verification.md#15--w-p1-vrfy-01) Add internal/identity OIDC verifier with cached JWKS and config

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-BLOCK-02`](user-block-list.md#23--w-p1-block-02) Enforce block list in the worker at CONNECT and per request; [`W-P1-VRFY-03`](identity-verification.md#35--w-p1-vrfy-03) Record user fields on events, receipts, logs and fleet ingest; [`W-P1-GPOL-03`](identity-policy.md#35--w-p1-gpol-03) Apply group-aware allow decisions at CONNECT and request time

### 3/5 · W-P1-VRFY-03

**Record user fields on events, receipts, logs and fleet ingest**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#23](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/23)

Add `UserSub, UserEmail, UserGroups []string, UserSID, IdentityStatus` to `analytics.Event`. Add the columns `user_sub, user_email, user_groups, user_sid, identity_status` with additive `ALTER TABLE` migrations in both the local SQLite and `fleet_sqlite.go`. Populate them in every StoreEvent call site in internal/proxy, using a helper on requestScope so no path is missed, and add them to `decisionLog`/`logDecision`. Confirm that sync/ingest JSON carries them and that receipts include them.

- [ ] An old warden.db and fleet DB upgrade in place with no data loss
- [ ] A signed receipt for an attributed request contains user_sub and verifies
- [ ] A grep test ensures every `StoreEvent(analytics.Event{` in internal/proxy uses the identity helper

### 5/5 · W-P1-VRFY-05

**Add Dex-backed identity e2e test behind the integration tag**

Type **test** · Size **M** · Issue [#25](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/25)

Under the integration build tag, start Dex (the pinned image from the recipe) or an in-process OIDC test issuer when Docker is unavailable. Run a worker in attribute mode and drive CONNECT requests with a valid token, an expired token, a token for the wrong audience, and no token, both through Proxy-Authorization and through X-Warden-Identity. Assert on event fields, the upstream headers seen, and the metric counters.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] All four token cases produce the expected IdentityStatus, and none are denied
- [ ] The test runs in CI's integration job and is skipped cleanly without the tag
